subject: Linguagens e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Apropriar-se do patrimônio artístico de diferentes tempos e lugares, compreendendo a sua diversidade, bem como os processos de legitimação das manifestações artísticas na sociedade, desenvolvendo visão crítica e histórica.

components.description_pt: Identificar expressões artísticas de diferentes tempos e lugares como parte de um patrimônio cultural diverso
components.description_en: Identify artistic expressions from different times and places as part of a diverse cultural heritage
components.cc_component_description: Identify cultural elements in fables and folktales from diverse traditions

components.description_pt: Analisar os processos pelos quais expressões artísticas são legitimadas na sociedade
components.description_en: Analyze the processes by which artistic expressions are legitimized in society
components.cc_component_description: Analyze what is emphasized in each artistic medium's treatment of a shared subject

components.description_pt: Desenvolver perspectiva crítica e histórica sobre o patrimônio artístico de diferentes culturas e períodos
components.description_en: Develop a critical and historical perspective on the artistic heritage of different cultures and periods
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how different cultures portray similar topics in myths and traditional literature

components.description_pt: Comparar expressões artísticas ao longo de períodos históricos para compreender sua diversidade e legitimização
components.description_en: Compare artistic expressions across historical periods to understand their diversity and legitimization
components.cc_component_description: Compare how a subject or key scene is represented in two different artistic mediums

cc_matches.description: Analyze the representation of a subject or a key scene in two different artistic mediums, including what is emphasized or absent in each treatment (e.g., Auden's "Musée des Beaux Arts" and Breughel's Landscape with the Fall of Icarus).
Recount stories, including fables and folktales from diverse cultures, and determine their central message, lesson, or moral.

Compare and contrast the treatment of similar themes and topics (e.g., opposition of good and evil) and patterns of events (e.g., the quest) in stories, myths, and traditional literature from different cultures.
